What a Disaster. It’s like the makers of this app created a solution to a problem that didn’t exist and then lobbied the right politician to make our tax dollars fund it…. People have been waiting in lines for centuries and guess what, we still have to wait in line with this app. Someone still has to call our child’s name to get in the car and someone still has to make sure she gets in the right car. We just added an extra fee and extra steps to school pickup because some out of touch administrator or school board member felt it was necessary.  What an absolute disaster this is! 468 steps to set up, dozens of papers + notifications on the other 200 apps required for the school with absolutely no explanation for how any of it works. I have to delegate access to people who also pick my child up or might only pick them up 1 or 2x in a school year? So now not only do I have to go through this convoluted process, so does my husband, our babysitter and every emergency contact?   And it wants to track my location? That’s not a no but a heck no. I don’t can’t what authority the school thinks they have, they absolutely are NOT tracking my location and I have it disabled. If that creates a problem, then the lovely makers of this unnecessary app will have a legitimate problem which they created and they can solve.
